rubric:
# Interaction labels: rubric

You label Magic: The Gathering cards for a Commander (EDH, 4-player) deck tool. For each card decide
whether it is INTERACTION (it stops, removes, neutralises or protects against what OPPONENTS do), and
what it answers. Read ONLY the oracle text, type line and mana cost given. NEVER use memory of what a
card does; if the text does not say it, it is not there. Reminder text in parentheses counts.

Output one JSON object per card, in input order, with exactly these fields:

- `name`: as given.
- `interaction`: `"yes"`, `"no"`, or `"ruling"`.
  - `"ruling"` ONLY for the three open owner questions: discard (Thoughtseize), theft/steal (Control
    Magic), static shut-offs and hate permanents (Torpor Orb, Null Rod, Rest in Peace, Grafdigger's
    Cage, Blood Moon, Drannith Magistrate). Still fill `kinds`/`answers` for them.
  - A card whose ONLY "protection" is for itself (hexproof while untapped, indestructible itself) is
    `"no"`: self-protection is not interaction.
  - Pure ramp/draw/value cards are `"no"`.
- `kinds`: array from this closed list (empty if `"no"`):
  `destroy`, `exile`, `bounce` (to hand), `tuck` (to library), `edict` (a player sacrifices of their
  choice), `damage` (deals damage to a creature/planeswalker/battle), `minus` (-N/-N or -X/-X),
  `neutralise` (Aura/transform/loses abilities/becomes a vanilla token, permanent stays), `steal`,
  `counter` (counter a spell or ability), `redirect` (change targets / copy-steal a spell),
  `shut-off` (static or activated effect that stops a class of things), `protect` (grants your
  permanents/you protection: hexproof, indestructible, protection from, phase out, shroud),
  `discard` (opponent discards), `graveyard-exile` (exiles cards from graveyards), `tax` (they must
  pay, e.g. Ghostly Prison), `wipe` is NOT a kind: a wipe is `destroy`/`exile`/... with scope `all`.
- `answers`: array of what it can remove or stop, from: `creature`, `artifact`, `enchantment`,
  `planeswalker`, `land`, `battle`, `permanent` (any nonland/any permanent: list `permanent` AND the
  types), `spell`, `noncreature-spell`, `creature-spell`, `instant-sorcery-spell`, `ability`
  (activated or triggered), `graveyard`, `hand`, `attackers`. For `protect`: what it protects, from:
  `your-creatures`, `your-permanents`, `one-creature`, `you` (the player), `your-commander`.
- `scope`: `target`, `all` (every matching permanent, a wipe), `each-opponent`, `choice` (opponent
  picks, edict), `self`, `static`, or `null`.
- `oneSided`: true if it only hits opponents' things (or only protects yours), false if symmetric
  (Wrath hits yours too), null if not applicable.
- `conditions`: a short quote of any condition that limits it ("if no mana was spent to cast it",
  "nonblack", "with mana value 3 or less", "unless its controller pays {2}", "two permanents with the
  same name"), or null.
- `givesBack`: a short quote if the opponent gets something (a token, a land, life, card, a free
  spell), or null.
- `why`: ONE sentence, quoting the decisive words of the oracle text.

Write the array of objects to the output file given to you as JSON (no comments, no trailing text).
